scorerVersion.description: Judges whether AdaptAbility's decision to escalate (or not escalate) a session was actually correct, per its own deterministic trigger rules (explicit human request, privacy concern or data privacy request, action required, employee/customer-specific case data, or an urgent deadline/safety-critical accommodation). Returns one of five text labels (correct_escalation, correct_containment, unnecessary_escalation, missed_escalation, unclear) as the recorded judgment text, using a single NotApplicable placeholder outcome mapping (the same pattern as Answer_Quality_Multi_Dim_Eval) so the platform does not rebind the engine to its own built-in deflection_defence template.
scorerVersion.label: Escalation Correctness Eval
